exposure: oral progesterone (200 mg Lutogel capsules per day)
outcome: latent phase (time from PL cessation to delivery)
neonatal intensive care unit admission frequency
cohort: 146 pregnant women admitted with preterm labor to a hospital in Kerman, Iran.
finding: There was no significant difference in the latent phase, average birth weight, and the neonatal intensive care unit admission frequency between groups receiving oral versus intramuscular progesterone.
gest_age: Women experiencing preterm labor (typically <37 weeks gestation at study entry)
